investigation.title: Swarm Gateway 502 Blocking All Remote Agent Checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime)
investigation.summary: All three remote-agents feature checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime) failed at 2026-10-06T12:38:59Z with an identical 502 bad_gateway error indicating the swarm gateway ELB endpoint was unreachable during agent provisioning. Because the failure occurs at POST /api/agents before any agent identity or VM state is returned, all required evidence (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState) is absent and every downstream contract assertion is unverifiable.
investigation.rootCause: The swarm gateway — the AWS ELB-backed upstream that the production-api proxies agent provisioning requests to at /v1/agents — was unreachable at the time of the eval run. The production-api returned HTTP 502 with code "bad_gateway" and an explicit "error sending request for url" message for every attempt, preventing agent creation from starting and leaving all required evidence fields empty. This is an infrastructure-layer failure localized to the swarm gateway dependency of POST /api/agents, not a failure of the eval runner itself or of the broader production-api service. No user-traffic or incident signals are present in the supplied evidence, so impact beyond the observability eval is unconfirmed.

possibleCauses: Primary: The swarm gateway ELB (us-east-2) was down, unhealthy, or had no healthy targets registered at the time of the eval run, causing the production-api to return 502 for all agent provisioning requests.

Tertiary: The swarm gateway service behind the ELB was deployed, restarted, or scaled to zero at the time of the eval, leaving the ELB with no healthy backends.

Lower probability: A misconfiguration of the ELB listener or target group (e.g., wrong port, wrong protocol, or a recently changed health-check path) caused all targets to be marked unhealthy simultaneously.

investigations.rootCause: The GitHub Actions workflow responsible for regenerating and publishing the observability snapshot at https://cypher-asi.github.io/aura-os/observability/status.json has not run successfully in at least 696 minutes (approximately 11.6 hours). The contract requires snapshotAgeMinutes <= 300 (5 hours). The snapshot content is otherwise structurally valid (all other assertions pass: schemaVersion=1, source=github-actions, hasLiveSource=true, hasNonUnknownFeatureData=true, featureCount=19), so the failure is isolated to the workflow not publishing a fresh snapshot within the required window. No user-traffic or incident signals are present in the evidence; this is an eval-layer staleness failure, not a confirmed user-facing outage.
